NEWSWIRE) -- Hilco Streambank (www.hilcostreambank.com) announced the successful completion of its efforts to liquidate certain intangible assets of RadioShack Corporation (OTCMKTS: RSHCQ). Following a two day auction at the New York City offices of Jones Day commencing on May 11 th, 2015, the winning bid of $26.2MM was made by General Wireless Operations Inc. The sale closed on June 19 th, 2015. As a result of this sale and the separate sales of rights to the RadioShack trademarks in Mexico, Latin America, the Middle East and North Africa, RadioShack generated proceeds of approximately $40 million from the sale of its intellectual property assets. The intangible assets included certain U.S and Foreign registered Trademarks, 73 active patents and pending patent applications, certain data in the RadioShack customer database, 295 registered domains - includi

General Wireless Operations Inc., doing business as RadioShack, announced today that it has closed on a $26.2 million purchase of the RadioShack brand, giving the company the ability to operate the retailer under the RadioShack brand name. "We are excited to be moving forward as a new and reinvigorated company under one of the most recognized consumer brand names of all time," said Ron Garriques, Chief Executive Officer of RadioShack. "Our stores serve over 1,200 communities, providing high-quality, high-value consumer electronics and accessories from globally recognized manufacturers and increasingly, with this acquisition, from exclusive brands that our customers know and trust such as Realistic®, AUVIO®, ENERCELL® Optimus® and more."
